MR Safety
The Iris Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. A person with the Iris Transcatheter Valve may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Iris Transcatheter Valve
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T only
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1000 Gauss/cm
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 2 W/kg
Scan Regions Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
